schedule: 03:15 local time daily, plus up to 15 minutes randomized delay

unit_files.graphmine-devlopment-backend-model.servi:
[Unit]
Description=GraphMine nightly backend models from observed runs

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/home/wajid/projects/graphDatabaseAgent/graphMine-database-cypher
ExecStart=:"/home/wajid/projects/graphDatabaseAgent/graphMine-database-cypher/.venv/bin/python" "/home/wajid/projects/graphDatabaseAgent/graphMine-database-cypher/deploy/train-backend-models.py" --config "/home/wajid/projects/graphDatabaseAgent/graphmine-data/environments/config/environments.json" --environment devlopment
TimeoutStartSec=1800
KillMode=control-group
Nice=10
Environment=OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=true
unit_files.graphmine-devlopment-backend-model.timer:
[Unit]
Description=Fit GraphMine backend models nightly

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 03:15:00
RandomizedDelaySec=15m
Persistent=true
Unit=graphmine-devlopment-backend-model.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
